say:1:1533904001:1.text: Tulumus! Don't close your eyes! Look at me, stay with me, just a little longer. The healer is coming. You'll be fine!
say:1:1533904001:1.source_cn: 图卢姆，求你……求你不要闭上眼睛！睁开眼看着我……撑一...

choice_prompt:2:1533904001.text: Tulumus! Don't close your eyes! Look at me, stay with me, just a little longer. The healer is coming. You'll be fine!
choice_prompt:2:1533904001.source_cn: 图卢姆，求你……求你不要闭上眼睛！睁开眼看着我……撑一下，再撑一撑，军医会来的，你一定会好起来的……

say:3:1533904002:0.text: He's fading fast... but if there's even a chance, I'll try!
say:3:1533904002:0.source_cn: 图卢姆已经快撑不住了……算了，不管是什么，我都愿意试一试！
say:3:1533904002:0.male: He's fading fast... but if there's even a chance, I'll try!
say:3:1533904002:0.female: He's fading fast... but if there's even a chance, I'll try!

narration:5:1533904003:0.text: The girl, Misi, takes the herb and gently feeds it to Tulumus.
narration:5:1533904003:0.source_cn: 少女弥斯接过草药，轻柔地喂给了图卢姆……

narration:6:1533904004:0.text: It'll take time to work. Let's wait nearby.

narration:6:1533904004:0.female: It'll take time to work. Let's wait nearby.

choice_prompt:7:1533904004.male: It'll take time to work. Let's wait nearby.
choice_prompt:7:1533904004.female: It'll take time to work. Let's wait nearby.

say:9:1533904005:1.text: Yes. I was delivering supplies to Mirehold. I lost my way and was attacked by beasts.
say:9:1533904005:1.source_cn: 嗯。那天我来水泽营地送东西，结果走错了路，被野兽袭击了。

say:10:1533904006:1.text: Someone saved me... but my wounds hurt so badly, I blacked out before I even saw his face.
say:10:1533904006:1.source_cn: 还好有人救了我，但是因为伤口太疼了，我还没来得及看清对...

say:11:1533904007:1.text: When I woke up, Tulumus was there. He had rescued me. He was so gentle... and he liked me, too!
say:11:1533904007:1.source_cn: 等我醒来的时候，图卢姆就在我身边。是他救了我，还对我那...

say:12:1533904008:1.text: Everything was perfect... until the patrol. Tulumus was sent to Wildborn lands and a snake bit him.
say:12:1533904008:1.source_cn: 一切都那么甜蜜……直到最近，图卢姆被派去兽人那边巡逻，...

say:13:1533904009:1.text: That kind of snake is only found in Wildborn lands, only they know the antidote. Even the army healers were helpless. I... I can't lose him...
say:13:1533904009:1.source_cn: 那种蛇只有雅库伯尔才有，只有兽人懂得怎么解毒，军医也没...

say:15:1533904010:1.text:
Ugh... Where... am I?
Misi... is that you?

say:16:1533904011:1.text: Tulumus! You're awake! It worked, the herb worked!
say:16:1533904011:1.source_cn: 图卢姆！天啊，你醒了……草药真的有用！

say:17:1533904012:1.text: Thank you. Thank you... This herb must be incredibly rare and expensive. Where did you even get it? Let me pay you back!
say:17:1533904012:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，谢谢你……这一定是很珍贵的草药吧，你从哪里买来...
say:17:1533904012:1.male: Thank you. Thank you... This herb must be incredibly rare and expensive. Where did you even get it? Let me pay you back!
say:17:1533904012:1.female: Thank you. Thank you... This herb must be incredibly rare and expensive. Where did you even get it? Let me pay you back!

choice_prompt:18:1533904012.source_cn: 谢谢你，谢谢你……这一定是很珍贵的草药吧，你从哪里买来的？我付钱给你！
choice_prompt:18:1533904012.male: Thank you. Thank you... This herb must be incredibly rare and expensive. Where did you even get it? Let me pay you back!
choice_prompt:18:1533904012.female: Thank you. Thank you... This herb must be incredibly rare and expensive. Where did you even get it? Let me pay you back!

say:19:1533904013:1.text: My love... You're safe... you're really safe...
